title: derby01: teams
description: The team colours. A round has 2 to 8 cars and car 1 drives for the first team, car 2 for the second, and so on.

teams.description: The eight teams in order, one for each car a round can have. Every team's ui colour must differ from the others': a paintball's colour tells the screens whose it is.

name.description: Shown on the scoreboard and as 'RED WINS'. A colour or a plain word, never a person or a brand.

paint.description: The car's body colour: the paint mask on the car model takes this colour.

ui.description: The brighter colour of the team's paintballs, splats, name tags and HUD. Must differ from every other team's.
